path_contract: All file and directory paths are relative to the workspace root. Absolute paths and escapes are rejected.

rules: Never encode blocked, empty and failed as the same empty string.
Do not return stack traces, secrets or unrestricted raw content.
Include truncation and pagination metadata when applicable.
Provider refusal and provider unavailability are failed; only harness policy, grant, validation or limit decisions are blocked.

model_tools.name: read_file
model_tools.description: Reads a text file from the workspace. Use it when you know the path and need what the file says, and always before editing it. To find a file by name use glob; to find text across files use grep_search.

file_path.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

offset.description: First line to return, zero-based. To continue a long file, pass the next_offset of the previous result.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

executor_invariants: A successful result reports total_lines, and next_offset when the file continues past the returned range.
A path that does not exist fails with path_not_found and names similar existing paths.

model_tools.name: write_file
model_tools.description: Creates a file, or replaces the whole content of an existing one. Use it for a new file or a complete rewrite. To change part of an existing file, use edit instead.

file_path.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

content.description: The complete content of the file, as UTF-8 text.

executor_invariants: Creating a file creates its missing parent directories.
Replacing an existing file needs no precondition from the model; the Operator's confirmation gate covers the write.
After an HTML write, page verification is controlled by config/harness.json and is not model-selectable.

model_tools.name: edit
model_tools.description: Changes part of an existing file by replacing an exact piece of its text. read_file the file first, copy the text to change into old_string exactly as it appears, and write its new version in new_string. Fails if old_string is not in the file or appears more than once. For a new file or a full rewrite use write_file.

file_path.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

old_string.description: The exact text to replace, copied from the file with its indentation and line breaks. Include enough surrounding lines to make it unique.

new_string.description: The text that replaces old_string. Use real line breaks and tabs, not the escapes \n and \t. Empty deletes old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string instead of requiring exactly one.

executor_invariants: old_string must occur exactly once unless replace_all is true; otherwise the edit fails and says how many times and on which lines it occurs.
A successful result returns an excerpt of the edited region so the model sees what it wrote.
The runtime parser must pass byte-for-byte whitespace round-trip tests before this tool is enabled.

model_tools.name: list_directory
model_tools.description: Lists the files and folders directly inside one directory. Use it to see what a folder contains. To find files by name anywhere in the workspace, use glob.

directory_path.description: Directory path relative to the workspace root; . is the root.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

model_tools.name: glob
model_tools.description: Finds files and folders whose path matches a pattern such as **/*.md. Use it when you know part of a name but not where it is. It does not look inside files; use grep_search for that.

pattern.description: Glob pattern. *.md matches only the chosen directory; **/*.md also searches every subdirectory.

directory_path.description: Directory path relative to the workspace root.

limit.description: Maximum number of paths to return.

model_tools.name: grep_search
model_tools.description: Searches for text inside files and returns each matching line with its file and line number. Use it to find where something is written. It does not match file names; use glob for that.

pattern.description: Text to search for, or a regular expression when is_regex is true.

directory_path.description: Directory path relative to the workspace root.

is_regex.description: When true, pattern is a regular expression.

ignore_case.description: When true, letter case is ignored.

include.description: Only search files whose path matches this glob, such as **/*.py.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

model_tools.name: web_search
model_tools.description: Searches the web and returns titles, URLs and snippets. Use it for news, current events, prices, recent releases and any fact you are not sure of, and to find a page whose URL you do not know. Then read the best result with web_fetch.

query.description: What to search for, written as a search engine query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

model_tools.name: web_fetch
model_tools.description: Reads the text of a web page from its URL. Use it when the Operator gives a URL, or to read a page that web_search found. The executor chooses HTTP or a browser internally.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL. Private, local, reserved and disallowed redirect targets are rejected.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to return, counted from the top of the page. Keep the default unless the page is known to be short: pages open with menus and notices before the text.

executor_invariants: Resolve and enforce SSRF policy before connecting and after every redirect.
HTTP is attempted first; browser escalation is internal and symptom-driven.
HTML extraction is shared and runs once before the result enters the model view.

model_tools.name: corpus_search
model_tools.description: Searches the documents the Operator attached to this conversation and returns passages with their source. Passages for the current question were already retrieved before this step; call it only to look for something else or with different words.

query.description: What to look for. Write it as a standalone question or phrase; earlier turns are not visible to the search.

limit.description: Maximum number of passages to return.

executor_invariants: Passages are returned verbatim, with the Document title, the heading path and the page when the source has one; the retrieval never paraphrases or translates stored text.
A passage collected from the web carries UntrustedWebTaint and the result declares the union of the taints it returned.
Nothing above the relevance floor is empty, never a passage returned to fill the answer.

model_tools.name: calculate
model_tools.description: Computes an arithmetic expression exactly. Use it for every calculation with large numbers, several steps or percentages instead of working it out yourself.

expression.description: Arithmetic expression using numbers, + - * / // % ** and parentheses.

executor_invariants: The expression is parsed into an AST and only arithmetic nodes are evaluated; no name, call or attribute is ever resolved.

model_tools.name: get_weather
model_tools.description: Gets the current weather and the daily forecast for a place. Use it whenever the Operator asks about weather, temperature, rain or wind somewhere.

location.description: Place name, optionally with region or country, such as "Recife, Brazil".

days.description: How many forecast days to return, starting today.

model_tools.name: describe_image
model_tools.description: Asks a local vision model one question about a PNG, JPEG or WebP image in the workspace and returns its answer. You cannot see images yourself: use it whenever the Operator mentions a screenshot, photo, receipt, chart or other image file. Ask for what the Operator needs from the image; when it shows a problem, ask it to transcribe every visible text, number and message rather than to describe the layout. The reading can be wrong on small text and digits.

file_path.description: Image path relative to the workspace root. Absolute paths and paths outside the workspace are rejected.

question.description: What to find in the image, as a specific question, e.g. 'What is the total on this receipt?' or 'Transcribe every field, value and message visible in this screenshot.'

executor_invariants: The image is size-checked before a byte is read and identified by magic bytes, not by extension.
Image bytes never enter the result, telemetry or CanonicalHistory; the result carries the answer, a fixed caveat and the image digest, size, format and dimensions.

prohibited_capabilities.name: run_shell_command
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Shell execution is excluded from the first release threat model.

prohibited_capabilities.name: code_interpreter
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Arbitrary code execution is excluded from the first release threat model.

prohibited_capabilities.name: verify_page
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Page verification is InternalAutomation and cannot be selected by the model.

prohibited_capabilities.name: browser
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Browser use is InternalAutomation behind guarded web_fetch and page verification.

prohibited_capabilities.name: web_extractor
prohibited_capabilities.reason: HTML extraction is InternalAutomation in the context layer.

prohibited_capabilities.name: display_image
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Showing an image to the Operator is UI, not a model tool; describe_image only reads.

prohibited_capabilities.name: remote_model
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Remote model egress is not available in the first release.
